sentences.en: And I feel like now, like, a firm that actually has gone, colleges can actually say, well, we don't really care about, like, your identity now.
sentences.zh: 我觉得现在，那些已经做出决定的公司，大学实际上可以说，好吧，我们现在真的不在乎你的身份了。

sentences.en: And there was panic.

sentences.en: Over news, it was being shared on Instagram.

sentences.en: It says here, like, in Missouri, the attorney general directed all colleges to immediately stop considering race and scholarships.
sentences.zh: 这里写着，在密苏里州，司法部长指示所有大学立即停止在奖学金发放中考虑种族因素。

sentences.en: About how the University of Missouri and the University of Kentucky would go beyond the ruling and end race-based scholarships.
sentences.zh: 关于密苏里大学和肯塔基大学将如何超越裁决，终止基于种族的奖学金。

sentences.en: Some of my peers saying, now I can't apply to this school or now I have to change this option.
sentences.zh: 我的一些同龄人说，现在我不能申请这所学校了，或者现在我必须改变这个选项。

sentences.en: And in the absence of answers, some were making up their own, sometimes wrongly.

sentences.en: You think that students might redact that they were part of, like, NAACP and...

sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.

sentences.en: And so it's leading some students to hide their race.
sentences.zh: 所以这导致一些学生隐藏他们的种族。

sentences.en: So it was a plus before, now you feel like it's a minus to be Black.
sentences.zh: 所以以前这是一种加分项，现在你觉得身为黑人反而成了减分项。

sentences.en: In the fear of, that's too race-related.
sentences.zh: 出于恐惧，觉得这太涉及种族了。

sentences.en: So now you're hiding that side of yourself to make others feel better in a way.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你为了让别人感觉好受些，在某种程度上隐藏了你自己的那一面。

sentences.en: And with all of this misinformation floating around...
sentences.zh: 随着所有这些错误信息四处流传……

sentences.en: Lunch is over.
sentences.zh: 午餐时间结束了。

sentences.en: Okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 好的，好的。

sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.zh: 祝你们下一场会议顺利。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: I mean, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我是说，谢谢你。

sentences.en: These questions and confusions eventually made their way inside the classroom.
sentences.zh: 这些问题和困惑最终进入了课堂。

sentences.en: Why is it that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: When two students sparred over, if you don't indicate your race in your essay, would colleges know at all?
sentences.zh: 当两名学生争论说，如果你不在论文中注明你的种族，大学还会知道吗？

sentences.en: When you fill out FAFSA, you still have to answer the race question.
sentences.zh: 当你填写联邦学生援助免费申请表（FAFSA）时，你仍然必须回答种族问题。

sentences.en: So it's not going to be just out of the question entirely.
sentences.zh: 所以这不会完全被排除在外。

sentences.en: Not like race is in a question at all.
sentences.zh: 并不是说种族问题完全不在考虑范围内。

sentences.en: And if you apply for financial aid, as students said, they would know.
sentences.zh: 而且正如学生们所说，如果你申请经济援助，他们就会知道。

sentences.en: Wouldn't they?
sentences.zh: 难道不是吗？

sentences.en: But then now the concern comes in is, will they tackle that as well?
sentences.zh: 但现在的问题是，他们也会解决这个问题吗？

sentences.en: Because they're already having...
sentences.zh: 因为他们已经在……

sentences.en: And if the schools knew their race, what would they do with that information?
sentences.zh: 如果学校知道了他们的种族，他们会用这些信息做什么呢？

sentences.en: There was a pause.
sentences.zh: 现场出现了一阵沉默。

sentences.en: I waited for the adults in the room to give some sort of answer.
sentences.zh: 我等待着房间里的成年人给出某种答案。

sentences.en: So we're going to, we're in our second session.
sentences.zh: 所以我们要，我们现在在进行第二场会议。

sentences.en: But no.

sentences.en: The writing coach gently guided their attention back to class.
sentences.zh: 写作教练温和地引导他们的注意力回到课堂上。

sentences.en: Let's make sure that we're being attentive.
sentences.zh: 让我们确保我们保持专注。

sentences.en: We want to be an active listener.
sentences.zh: 我们要成为积极的倾听者。

sentences.en: I eventually looked into this, and the schools, in fact, wouldn't know a student's race from financial aid forMs.
sentences.zh: 我最终查了一下，事实上，学校不会从经济援助表格中得知学生的种族。

sentences.en: But no one at the workshop told the kids this.
sentences.zh: 但研讨会上没有人告诉孩子们这一点。

sentences.en: So the writing workshop continued business as usual.
sentences.zh: 所以写作研讨会照常进行。

sentences.en: Between classes, I had asked the head of Peer Ford, which is guiding all these kids, how their guidance would change as a result of the affirmative action ban.
sentences.zh: 在课间，我问了指导所有这些孩子的 Peer Ford 的负责人，由于平权行动禁令，他们的指导方针会有什么改变。

sentences.en: He said it doesn't.
sentences.zh: 他说没有改变。

sentences.en: He told me they were still waiting to hear more from colleges themselves about how the ruling might change their admissions formula.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，他们仍在等待大学方面关于裁决可能如何改变其录取公式的更多消息。

sentences.en: So after the workshop, I started reaching out to those admissions offices.
sentences.zh: 所以研讨会结束后，我开始联系那些招生办公室。

sentences.en: And it turns out the people charged with implementing the court's decision are just as confused as the students applying.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，负责执行法院裁决的人和申请的学生一样困惑。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.zh: 我是 Sam Azersky，我每天负责创建 Spelling Bee 和 Letterboxd 游戏。

sentences.zh: 我有一种叫联觉的东西。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: After my trip to the writing workshop in Rochester, I wanted to get a better understanding of how admissions offices around the country were going to change.
sentences.zh: 在罗切斯特的写作研讨会之行后，我想更好地了解全国各地的招生办公室将如何改变。

sentences.en: Out of the thousands of universities and colleges in the U.S., a small percentage, some put the number around 10%, are actually affected by the decision.
sentences.zh: 在美国成千上万所大学中，只有一小部分，有人估计在 10% 左右，实际上受到了该裁决的影响。

sentences.en: The ones who are practicing affirmative action in the first place.
sentences.zh: 那些原本就在实行平权行动的学校。

sentences.en: But the small percentage are the most selective in the United States.
sentences.zh: 但这一小部分却是美国最具选择性的学校。

sentences.en: Think the top 100 colleges in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 想想美国排名前 100 的大学。

sentences.en: News & World Report.
sentences.zh: 新闻与世界报道。

sentences.en: Colleges that are known for their outsized ability to help students from poor backgrounds become high earners after graduation.
sentences.zh: 这些大学以其超强的能力而闻名，能帮助贫困背景的学生在毕业后成为高收入者。

sentences.en: So these were the colleges I started to call.
sentences.zh: 所以这些就是我开始联系的大学。

sentences.en: Hi, how's it going?
sentences.zh: 嗨，最近怎么样？

sentences.en: Hey, Jeff.
sentences.zh: 嘿，杰夫。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Good, how are you?
sentences.zh: 很好，你呢？

sentences.en: Hey, Jeff.
sentences.zh: 嘿，杰夫。

sentences.en: Hi, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嗨，你好吗？

sentences.en: Gary, thank you so much for taking the time to talk.
sentences.zh: 加里，非常感谢你抽出时间交谈。

sentences.en: How are you doing today?
sentences.zh: 你今天过得怎么样？

sentences.en: I called over 30 people inside the admissions world.
sentences.zh: 我给招生界的 30 多个人打了电话。

sentences.en: So we're still trying to understand, you know, I would say the ruling specifically for
sentences.zh: 所以我们仍在努力理解，你知道，我会说专门针对卡尔顿大学的裁决，

sentences.en: Carleton and we're working with our legal counsel to ask some of these specific questions.
sentences.zh: 我们正在与我们的法律顾问合作，提出一些具体的问题。

sentences.en: Some admissions offices never responded to my requests.
sentences.zh: 一些招生办公室从未回复我的请求。

sentences.en: Some admissions offices wanted to talk, but were vetoed by their general counsel.
sentences.zh: 一些招生办公室想谈谈，但被他们的总法律顾问否决了。

sentences.en: Some would only talk to me off the record.
sentences.zh: 有些人只愿意私下跟我谈。

sentences.en: A college can be sued for many, many reasons in a time when there's a substantial movement in the United States that seems to be reacting against even the mere idea of diversity.
sentences.zh: 在当今美国，一场似乎连多样性这一理念本身都在抵制的运动中，大学可能因各种各样的原因被起诉。

sentences.en: And that's because colleges are treading this new terrain cautiously.
sentences.zh: 这是因为大学正在谨慎地踏入这片新领域。

sentences.en: No school wants to end up in the legal battle like Harvard did, who was a defendant on the case that led to the overturning of affirmative action.
sentences.zh: 没有学校想陷入像哈佛大学那样的法律纠纷，哈佛是导致平权行动被推翻的案件的被告。

sentences.en: The trial unearthed embarrassing discoveries about Harvard's notoriously opaque admissions
sentences.zh: 审判揭露了关于哈佛臭名昭著的不透明招生系统的令人尴尬的发现，

sentences.en: system, including something called a personal score, which admissions officers use to rank
sentences.zh: 包括所谓的个人评分，招生官用它来评估申请人的自信心和讨喜程度等特质，

sentences.en: traits like an applicant's self-confidence and likability, and routinely scored Asian applicants near the bottom.
sentences.zh: 并且经常将亚裔申请人的评分排在底部。

sentences.en: And Harvard is still being investigated for its mission practices.
sentences.zh: 而且哈佛的招生做法仍在接受调查。

sentences.en: But the other admissions officers that did talk to me started to give me a sense of what it's like inside the schools.
sentences.zh: 但其他与我交谈的招生官开始让我了解学校内部的情况。

sentences.en: Hey, Matt.
sentences.zh: 嘿，马特。

sentences.en: Hello, hello.
sentences.zh: 你好，你好。

sentences.en: Matt McGann is the Dean of Admissions and Financial Aid at Amherst College, a small liberal arts college in Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 马特·麦甘是马萨诸塞州一所小型文理学院——阿默斯特学院的招生与经济援助院长。

sentences.en: It has an acceptance rate of 7%.
sentences.zh: 它的录取率为 7%。

sentences.en: Because we do want to attract a diverse applicant pool, we do believe that a diverse student body makes for a better residential liberal arts education.
sentences.zh: 因为我们确实想吸引多元化的申请者群体，我们确实相信多元化的学生群体能带来更好的住宿文理教育。

sentences.en: Currently, about half of its student body are students of color.
sentences.zh: 目前，其学生群体中约有一半是有色人种学生。

sentences.en: Even before this decision, race was never by itself the reason why someone would be admitted.
sentences.zh: 即使在这一裁决之前，种族也从来不是某人被录取的唯一原因。

sentences.en: McGann told me that before the ruling, Amherst achieved this diverse student body in part by considering race among a variety of factors.
sentences.zh: 麦甘告诉我，在裁决之前，阿默斯特学院实现这种多元化的学生群体，部分是通过将种族作为多种因素之一来考虑的。

sentences.en: Do you play a sport?
sentences.zh: 你参加体育运动吗？

sentences.en: Do you play the French horn?
sentences.zh: 你会吹圆号吗？

sentences.en: Did you grow up white and on a farm?
sentences.zh: 你是白人且在农场长大的吗？

sentences.en: Or Black in an inner city?
sentences.zh: 还是在内城长大的黑人？

sentences.en: Race was just one piece of the puzzle.
sentences.zh: 种族只是拼图中的一小块。

sentences.en: It was always one of many parts of a whole person review.
sentences.zh: 它始终是全人审查的众多部分之一。

sentences.en: To better understand a student's context, to better understand a student's life, but never it by itself, never a determining factor.
sentences.zh: 为了更好地了解学生的背景，更好地了解学生的生活，但绝不是唯一的，绝不是决定性因素。

sentences.en: What McGann told me is something I heard from every admissions office I talked to, that race by itself was not determinative.
sentences.zh: 麦甘告诉我的话，我在与每一位招生官交谈时都听到了，即种族本身并不具有决定性。

sentences.en: But the Supreme Court disagreed, saying that race was determinative for a significant percentage of admitted Black and Hispanic students at Harvard and UNC.
sentences.zh: 但最高法院不同意，称对于哈佛和北卡罗来纳大学录取的相当大比例的黑人和西班牙裔学生来说，种族具有决定性作用。

sentences.en: And now places like Amherst have lost their ability to consider race.
sentences.zh: 而现在，像阿默斯特这样的地方已经失去了考虑种族的能力。

sentences.en: We're going from a time where we can consider everything that a student wants us to consider to there being one aspect that remains important in society that we must ignore.
sentences.zh: 我们正从一个我们可以考虑学生希望我们考虑的一切的时代，走向一个社会中仍然重要的方面我们却必须忽略的时代。

sentences.en: When the affirmative action cases got to the Supreme Court's door, McGann, along with many administrators at Amherst, sent an amicus brief to the court and predicted that without
sentences.zh: 当平权行动案件到达最高法院门口时，麦甘和阿默斯特的许多行政人员向法院提交了一份法庭之友陈述书，并预测如果没有平权行动，

sentences.en: affirmative action, the number of Black students on their campuses will drop from 7% to 2%.
sentences.zh: 他们校园里的黑人学生人数将从 7% 下降到 2%。

sentences.en: And after the court's ruling, McGann and his team at Amherst poured over the decision, which came in the form of a 237-page PDF.
sentences.zh: 在法院裁决后，麦甘和他在阿默斯特的团队仔细研读了这份裁决，它以一份 237 页的 PDF 形式发布。

sentences.en: You know, like, we didn't get the chance to ask the Supreme Court, like, right, so we do this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们没有机会问最高法院，对吧，所以我们这样做。

sentences.en: Like, so what now?
sentences.zh: 那么现在该怎么办？

sentences.en: Like, it's not a step-by-step manual.
sentences.zh: 它不是一步一步的操作手册。

sentences.en: So we're left with the work to figure out how we make sure that we're compliance with everything.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须自己努力弄清楚如何确保我们遵守一切规定。

sentences.en: But what does being in compliance mean exactly?
sentences.zh: 但合规到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: Unlike with sports, orchestra, and geographic status, race is now off the table.
sentences.zh: 与体育、管弦乐队和地理状况不同，种族现在被排除在外了。

sentences.en: But what if participating in an extracurricular, like, the Black Student Union has to do with race?
sentences.zh: 但如果参加课外活动，比如黑人学生会，与种族有关呢？

sentences.en: How would that work?
sentences.zh: 那会怎么运作？

sentences.en: And so, just to get specific, like, with an extracurricular activity, for instance, where a
sentences.zh: 所以，具体来说，以课外活动为例，如果一个学生说他们是黑人学生会的成员，

sentences.en: student says that they were a member of the BSU, how could that have been considered before the affirmative action ruling, and what changes about it after?
sentences.zh: 在平权行动裁决之前，这会被如何考虑，而在裁决之后，它又有什么变化？

sentences.en: So, that cannot be put in the context of, well, so, understanding a student's participation
sentences.zh: 所以，这不能被置于那种语境中，嗯，所以，通过种族地位的视角来理解学生参与某项活动，

sentences.en: in an activity through a lens of racial status is something that, at the very least, cannot be as easily done anymore.
sentences.zh: 至少在目前，已经不能那么容易做到了。

sentences.en: We're still working on our training and guideline language on how the admissions staff should approach these questions.
sentences.zh: 我们仍在制定关于招生人员应如何处理这些问题的培训和指导语言。

sentences.en: We're still working on that.
sentences.zh: 我们仍在努力解决这个问题。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much for your time, and good luck with the next admissions cycle, and again, thank you for the time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，非常感谢你抽出时间，祝下一轮招生周期顺利，再次感谢你的时间。

sentences.en: It's been an interesting conversation, and I appreciate your thoughtful approach to it.
sentences.zh: 这是一次有趣的谈话，我很欣赏你深思熟虑的切入点。

sentences.en: So, best wishes.
sentences.zh: 那么，祝一切顺利。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Cheers.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: The dean at Amherst isn't the only one scratching his head over this ruling.
sentences.zh: 阿默斯特学院的院长并不是唯一对这项裁决感到困惑的人。

sentences.en: In several on-and-off-the-record conversations with current and former deans of admissions, they expressed tremendous uncertainty about how all of this is going to work.
sentences.zh: 在与现任和前任招生院长进行的多场公开或私下的谈话中，他们对这一切将如何运作表达了极大的不确定性。

sentences.en: How you not consider a race, when it can be so apparent in things like a student's extracurriculars, their last name, their essay topic.
sentences.zh: 当种族在学生的课外活动、姓氏、论文主题等方面表现得如此明显时，你怎么能不考虑种族呢？

sentences.en: But as I continued to talk to admissions officers, I finally started to get somewhere.
sentences.zh: 但随着我继续与招生官员交谈，我终于开始有所收获。

sentences.en: They seemed to all point to a key passage in the decision that was in this moment of darkness, a kind of North Star.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎都指向了裁决中一段关键的文字，那段文字在黑暗时刻犹如北极星一般。

sentences.en: Chief Justice Roberts wrote it, and it goes,
sentences.zh: 首席大法官罗伯茨写道，内容是：

sentences.en: Nothing in this opinion should be construed as prohibiting universities from considering an applicant's
sentences.zh: 本意见书中的任何内容，均不得被解释为禁止大学考虑申请人

sentences.en: discussion of how race affected his or her life, be it through discrimination, inspiration, or otherwise.
sentences.zh: 关于种族如何影响其生活的论述，无论是通过歧视、激励还是其他方式。

sentences.en: But he says,
sentences.zh: 但他又说：

sentences.en: A benefit to a student who overcame racial discrimination, for example, must be tied to that student's courage and determination.
sentences.zh: 例如，给予克服种族歧视的学生的优待，必须与该学生的勇气和决心挂钩。

sentences.en: Or, a benefit to a student whose heritage or culture motivated him or her to assume a leadership
sentences.zh: 或者，给予那些因其传统或文化而受到激励，从而承担领导

sentences.en: role or attain a particular goal must be tied to that student's unique ability to contribute to the university.
sentences.zh: 角色或实现特定目标的学生的优待，必须与该学生为大学做出贡献的独特能力挂钩。

sentences.en: In other words, the student must be treated on the basis of his or her experiences as an individual, not on the basis of race.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，必须基于学生作为个人的经历来对待他们，而不是基于种族。

sentences.en: So what does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那么这意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: Roberts says that if a student does write about race, you as the admissions officer will now have to connect race to a lived experience, like overcoming discrimination.
sentences.zh: 罗伯茨说，如果学生确实写到了种族，作为招生官员，你现在必须将种族与生活经历联系起来，比如克服歧视的经历。

sentences.en: Then you'd have to explain how overcoming discrimination uniquely connects to the mission of the college,
sentences.zh: 然后你必须解释克服歧视的经历如何与大学的使命独特地联系在一起，

sentences.en: like how overcoming discrimination shows resilience and promise, and these are the students that we're looking for.
sentences.zh: 比如克服歧视如何展现了韧性和潜力，而这些正是我们正在寻找的学生。

sentences.en: The distinctions between race and race as a lived experience is a granular distinction, and I wasn't sure how it would play out.
sentences.zh: 种族与作为生活经历的种族之间的区别是一个细微的差别，我不确定它会如何演变。

sentences.en: But by the fall, as colleges launch their applications on the Common App, I begin to notice a new kind of essay question pop up.
sentences.zh: 但到了秋天，随着各大学在通用申请系统（Common App）上发布申请，我开始注意到一种新的论文题目出现。

sentences.en: Over and over again, I kept seeing schools introduce new supplemental essay prompts that draw words directly from Roberts' passage.
sentences.zh: 我一次又一次地看到学校引入新的补充论文提示，直接引用了罗伯茨那段话中的词句。

sentences.en: Prompts like, talk about lived experiences and how you could uniquely contribute to their campus.
sentences.zh: 比如谈论生活经历以及你如何能为他们的校园做出独特贡献的提示。

sentences.en: It was a subtle change, but a change nonetheless.
sentences.zh: 这是一个微妙的变化，但确实是变化。

sentences.en: For example, Brown University used to ask his applicants to write, quote, about a time when you were challenged by a perspective that differed from your own.
sentences.zh: 例如，布朗大学过去要求申请人写，引用：“关于你曾受到与自己观点不同的观点挑战的时刻”。

sentences.en: Here, it allowed applicants to argue that by simply belonging to a minority group, other students can learn from them, and vice versa.
sentences.zh: 在这里，它允许申请人论证，仅仅因为属于少数群体，其他学生就可以从他们身上学到东西，反之亦然。

sentences.en: It relied on a previous Supreme Court precedent that says colleges can use affirmative action to create a diverse learning environment.
sentences.zh: 它依赖于最高法院之前的一项先例，该先例称大学可以使用平权行动来创造多元化的学习环境。

sentences.en: But after the overturning of that precedent, Brown replaced it with a new prompt this year, with words drawn directly from Roberts.
sentences.zh: 但在该先例被推翻后，布朗大学今年用一个新的提示取代了它，其中的词句直接取自罗伯茨的意见书。

sentences.en: It read, share how an aspect of your growing up has inspired or challenged you, and what unique contributions this might allow you to make to the Brown community.
sentences.zh: 它写道：分享你成长过程中的某个方面是如何激励或挑战你的，以及这可能使你为布朗社区做出什么样的独特贡献。

sentences.en: The key change here is that there is now a right kind of race essay and a wrong kind.
sentences.zh: 这里的关键变化是，现在有了“正确的”种族论文和“错误的”种族论文之分。

sentences.en: And in the end, I found that at least 20 selective colleges, including several in the Ivy League, had changed their essay questions this year, using words from Roberts' passage.
sentences.zh: 最终，我发现至少有20所选拔性大学，包括几所常春藤盟校，今年都更改了他们的论文题目，使用了罗伯茨那段话中的词句。

sentences.en: But the students this year will have a hard time understanding this distinction on their own.
sentences.zh: 但今年的学生很难自己理解这种区别。

sentences.en: The plaintiffs will look at any institution that doesn't see a dip and wonder, were you like wink-wink using a proxy but really going against the law?
sentences.zh: 原告会盯着任何录取人数没有下降的机构，心想：你们是不是在暗中搞小动作，但实际上是在违背法律？

sentences.en: So, you know, I want to be really clear, and I would want you to print that Colorado College is going to follow the law.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我想说清楚，我希望你刊登出来，科罗拉多学院将会遵守法律。

sentences.en: I know that it's an optimistic goal to try to maintain compositional diversity, and we probably won't, to be honest with you, but I don't want to set a goal that we will.
sentences.zh: 我知道试图保持组成多样性是一个乐观的目标，老实说，我们可能做不到，但我不想设定一个我们一定会做到的目标。

sentences.en: You know, we've got to set aspirational goals.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们必须设定有抱负的目标。

sentences.en: But you're right that our numbers probably will decline.
sentences.zh: 但你说得对，我们的数字可能会下降。

sentences.en: In my conversations with admissions deans, they told me their schools were still committed to diversity.
sentences.zh: 在与招生院长的谈话中，他们告诉我，他们的学校仍然致力于多元化。

sentences.en: But the schools are in a bit of a bind.
sentences.zh: 但这些学校陷入了困境。

sentences.en: If they produce the same level of racial diversity in the incoming year as the year before the ruling, they put themselves at legal risk.
sentences.zh: 如果他们在入学年份产生的种族多样性水平与裁决前一年相同，他们就会让自己面临法律风险。

sentences.en: The anti-affirmative action opposition are on the lookout for schools that, behind the closed doors of admissions offices,
sentences.zh: 反对平权行动的势力正在寻找那些在招生办公室的闭门会议后，

sentences.en: are practicing a kind of under-the-table affirmative action.
sentences.zh: 实行某种暗箱操作的平权行动的学校。

sentences.en: I talked to Jeff Brenzel, who was the dean of admissions at Yale, but is now working with Morehouse College
sentences.zh: 我采访了曾任耶鲁大学招生院长的杰夫·布伦泽尔，他现在与莫尔豪斯学院合作，

sentences.en: to figure out what this new world of admissions is starting to look like.
sentences.zh: 以弄清楚这个新的招生世界开始是什么样子。

sentences.en: He crunched the numbers.
sentences.zh: 他计算了这些数字。

sentences.en: He estimates that there will be a 20 to 30 percent drop in Black enrollment in the top 100 colleges.
sentences.zh: 他估计，前100所大学的黑人入学率将下降20%到30%。

sentences.en: He says he expects HBCUs, like Morehouse, to catch some of those 20 to 30 percent.
sentences.zh: 他说他预计像莫尔豪斯这样的传统黑人大学（HBCU）会接收这20%到30%中的一部分学生。

sentences.en: But it's unclear how many of those students those colleges can actually support.
sentences.zh: 但不清楚这些学院实际上能支持多少这样的学生。

sentences.en: And as for Latino students, no one I talked to has speculated on where they might wind up.
sentences.zh: 至于拉丁裔学生，我采访的任何人都没有推测他们最终会去哪里。

sentences.en: I asked McGann at Amherst, given all of this, whether students of color are applying this year, who have a harder time getting into schools.
sentences.zh: 我问阿默斯特学院的麦甘，鉴于这一切，今年有色人种学生是否在申请那些更难进入的学校。

sentences.en: Schools like AmherSt.
sentences.zh: 像阿默斯特这样的学校。

sentences.en: I would hope that that student would know that, you know, nothing about this changes who they are.
sentences.zh: 我希望那些学生能知道，你知道，这一切都不会改变他们是谁。

sentences.en: And it's incumbent upon the colleges.
sentences.zh: 而且这是大学的责任。

sentences.en: It's not the student's job.
sentences.zh: 这不是学生的工作。

sentences.en: The student should present themselves as wholly and fully and as best they can.
sentences.zh: 学生应该尽可能完整、充分地展示自己。

sentences.en: And it's on the colleges to lawfully consider and have an admission process that allows them to live up to their mission.
sentences.zh: 大学有责任合法地考虑并制定一个录取流程，使他们能够履行自己的使命。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太棒了。

sentences.en: And you're holding it to your ear like you're on the phone.
sentences.zh: 你把它贴在耳朵上，就像在打电话一样。

sentences.en: Just weeks before Francesco submitted his application to MIT,
sentences.zh: 就在弗朗切斯科向麻省理工学院提交申请的前几周，

sentences.en: I called him after school.
sentences.zh: 我放学后给他打了电话。

sentences.en: To start, I would just love to know, like, how you're feeling about the applications you have so far.
sentences.zh: 首先，我很想知道，你对目前的申请感觉如何。

sentences.en: Oh, I really like it.
sentences.zh: 哦，我真的很喜欢。

sentences.en: I feel that it speaks to who I am.
sentences.zh: 我觉得它表达了我是一个什么样的人。

sentences.en: I wanted to know where he landed, whether he ended up mentioning race in his application essay.
sentences.zh: 我想知道他的最终决定，他是否在申请论文中提到了种族。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I don't think I did.
sentences.zh: 我想我没有。

sentences.en: I did try to stay away from it.
sentences.zh: 我确实尽量避开了它。

sentences.en: He says even though race is still a big part of who he is, it's not the thing he wants admissions officers to see.
sentences.zh: 他说，尽管种族仍然是他个人身份的重要组成部分，但这并不是他想让招生官员看到的东西。

sentences.en: I don't want to be categorized saying, oh, he's Hispanic.
sentences.zh: 我不想被归类，被贴上“哦，他是西班牙裔”的标签。

sentences.en: Then saying like, oh, look at what he's done.
sentences.zh: 然后说，哦，看看他做了什么。

sentences.en: He's done this.
sentences.zh: 他做了这个。

sentences.en: He's done that.
sentences.zh: 他做了那个。

sentences.en: I was actually speaking to one of my friends about it.
sentences.zh: 我其实正和我的一个朋友谈论这件事。

sentences.en: We were saying it's essentially been like, I guess, confined to like a box.
sentences.zh: 我们当时说，这基本上就像是被关进了一个盒子里。

sentences.en: And it's like, oh, what race are you?
sentences.zh: 就像是，哦，你是什么种族？

sentences.en: Like Hispanic.
sentences.zh: 比如西班牙裔。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And I have pride for my races.
sentences.zh: 我对我的种族感到自豪。

sentences.en: I'm not saying like, oh, I'm ashamed.
sentences.zh: 我不是说，哦，我感到羞耻。

sentences.en: But specifically pertaining to college application,
sentences.zh: 但具体到大学申请，

sentences.en: I want to show them who I am as a person.
sentences.zh: 我想向他们展示我作为一个人的样子。

sentences.en: What my dreams are, what I like, what are my aspirations, who I am.
sentences.zh: 我的梦想是什么，我喜欢什么，我的抱负是什么，我是谁。

sentences.en: When you think about someone boxing you in because they know your racial background, what do you think that boxing in is?
sentences.zh: 当你想到有人因为知道你的种族背景而把你框住时，你认为那种框住是什么？

sentences.en: Or what do you think that boxing in means?
sentences.zh: 或者你认为那种框住意味着什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, I want to be confined by saying, oh, they have this preconceived notion of me being Hispanic.
sentences.zh: 是的，我不想被限制，因为他们对我作为西班牙裔有这种先入为主的观念。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And I don't know their attitudes or their feelings,
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们的态度或感受，

sentences.en: but whether I like it or not, there are people in the world who don't like my race or just, they have differing opinions.
sentences.zh: 但无论我是否喜欢，世界上确实有人不喜欢我的种族，或者他们有不同的意见。

sentences.en: And that's okay.
sentences.zh: 那没关系。

sentences.en: People have their right to have their own opinions, but I want to go in saying who I am.
sentences.zh: 人们有权拥有自己的观点，但我希望进去时能展现我是谁。

sentences.en: So if I ever were to be confined in that box, essentially an issue for me.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我真的被关进那个盒子里，对我来说基本上是个问题。

sentences.en: It's a way to play safe.
sentences.zh: 这是一种求稳的方式。

sentences.en: Yeah, just play it safe.
sentences.zh: 是的，就是求稳。

sentences.en: You know, in a world where affirmative action was still practiced by colleges and by admissions officers where it would actually be a favor to you,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在一个大学和招生官员仍然实行平权行动，并且实际上对你有利的世界里，

sentences.en: would you have mentioned your racial background?
sentences.zh: 你会提到你的种族背景吗？

sentences.en: If it were an advantage to me, then I'd take it.
sentences.zh: 如果它对我有利，那我会利用它。

sentences.en: But now that it's gone, I'd rather play it safe.
sentences.zh: 但现在它消失了，我宁愿求稳。

sentences.en: His decision is fueled in part by the same narrative I heard from the other students at the workshop six months ago, which is this feeling of increasing distruSt.
sentences.zh: 他的决定在一定程度上受到我六个月前在研讨会上从其他学生那里听到的同样叙事的影响，那就是一种日益增长的不信任感。

sentences.en: Francesco knew that affirmative action guaranteed that his race could only help him.
sentences.zh: 弗朗切斯科知道，平权行动保证了他的种族只会对他有帮助。

sentences.en: But now that that protection is gone, he's worried that the discrimination he sees everywhere else in the world could now enter the admissions process.
sentences.zh: 但现在这种保护消失了，他担心他在世界上其他地方看到的歧视现在可能会进入招生过程。

sentences.en: Because at the end of the day, the world is not a kind place.
sentences.zh: 因为归根结底，这个世界并不是一个友善的地方。

sentences.en: As much as I don't like it,
sentences.zh: 尽管我不喜欢它，

sentences.en: I got to deal with it, especially heading into the adult world.
sentences.zh: 但我必须面对它，尤其是在进入成人世界的时候。

sentences.en: It's kind of scary and confusing.
sentences.zh: 这有点可怕和令人困惑。

sentences.en: But I'm also trying to keep an open mind
sentences.zh: 但我也在努力保持开放的心态，

sentences.en: and just figure my way out through this world, this new world I'm entering.
sentences.zh: 并试图在这个世界，这个我正在进入的新世界中找到自己的路。

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, I met up with Jordan, who, if you remember, was working on his essay on the movie Training Day.
sentences.zh: 几周前，我见到了乔丹，如果你还记得的话，他当时正在写关于电影《训练日》的论文。

sentences.en: He ended up scrapping that altogether.
sentences.zh: 他最终完全放弃了那个主题。

sentences.en: He said he thought more about the court's ruling.
sentences.zh: 他说他更多地思考了法院的裁决。

sentences.en: And unlike Francesco, he decided he would not only mention his race, but he was going to dedicate the topic of his essay to his identity,
sentences.zh: 与弗朗切斯科不同，他决定不仅要提到他的种族，而且要将论文的主题专门用于他的身份，

sentences.en: about growing up as a Black kid in the Bronx, he said.
sentences.zh: 关于作为一个在布朗克斯长大的黑人孩子，他说。

sentences.en: If the Supreme Court ruling says race doesn't matter, he's saying race matters to me, and this is how.
sentences.zh: 如果最高法院的裁决说种族无关紧要，他想说种族对我来说很重要，这就是原因。

sentences.en: And that's the choice a generation of 17-year-olds is having to make in a moment as formative as applying to college.
sentences.zh: 这就是一代17岁的年轻人在申请大学这样具有塑造性的时刻所必须做出的选择。

sentences.en: Do they choose to define themselves by their race, like Jordan?
sentences.zh: 他们是选择像乔丹那样通过种族来定义自己吗？

sentences.en: Or do they hide their race, like Francesco?
sentences.zh: 还是像弗朗切斯科那样隐藏自己的种族？

sentences.en: And while that choice may or may not mean the difference between getting in and not, it will almost certainly shape how they see themselves and how they think the world sees them.
sentences.zh: 虽然这种选择可能意味着录取与否的区别，也可能不是，但它几乎肯定会塑造他们如何看待自己，以及他们认为世界如何看待他们。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: The Islamic State has claimed responsibility for the bombing attack that killed 84 people in Iran on Wednesday, a claim that, according to the Times,
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰国声称对周三在伊朗造成84人死亡的爆炸袭击负责，据《泰晤士报》报道，这一声明，

sentences.en: aligns with an intelligence assessment by American officials.
sentences.zh: 与美国官员的情报评估相吻合。

sentences.en: The claim is significant because some Iranian leaders had initially sought to blame Israel for the attack, raising fears that Israel's war in Gaza
sentences.zh: 这一声明意义重大，因为一些伊朗领导人最初试图将袭击归咎于以色列，引发了人们对以色列在加沙的战争

sentences.en: could widen into a regional conflict.
sentences.zh: 可能扩大为地区冲突的担忧。

sentences.en: Now that ISIS has said it was responsible, that possibility seems less likely.
sentences.zh: 既然ISIS已经表示对此负责，这种可能性似乎降低了。

sentences.en: And new documents released by congressional Democrats show that during Donald Trump's presidency, his businesses received at least $7.8 million from 20 foreign governments,
sentences.zh: 国会民主党人发布的新文件显示，在唐纳德·特朗普担任总统期间，他的企业从20个外国政府获得了至少780万美元，

sentences.en: most of it from China.
sentences.zh: 其中大部分来自中国。
